results.question: How many orders are there for each status?
What is the monthly revenue from delivered orders after discounts?
results.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at) AS month,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) - o.discount_cents) AS monthly_revenue_cents
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month ASC;
results.final_sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at) AS month,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) - o.discount_cents) AS monthly_revenue_cents

results.question: Which categories have the highest gross value of products sold in delivered orders before discounts? Show all categories.
results.initial_sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        p.category_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS gross_value
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE
        o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY
        o.order_id, p.category_id
)
SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.name,
    SUM(do.gross_value) AS total_gross_value
FROM
    categories c
LEFT JOIN
    delivered_orders do ON c.category_id = do.category_id
GROUP BY
    c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY
    total_gross_value DESC;
results.final_sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        p.category_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) AS gross_value
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE
        o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY
        o.order_id, p.category_id
)
SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.name,
    SUM(do.gross_value) AS total_gross_value
FROM
    categories c
LEFT JOIN
    delivered_orders do ON c.category_id = do.category_id
GROUP BY
    c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY
    total_gross_value DESC;

results.question: Show the 10 products with the highest average rating, considering only products with at least five reviews.
results.initial_sql:
WITH avg_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name,
        AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
    FROM
        products p
    JOIN
        reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
    GROUP BY
        p.product_id, p.name
    HAVING
        COUNT(r.review_id) >= 5
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    name,
    average_rating
FROM
    avg_ratings
ORDER BY
    average_rating DESC, product_id ASC
LIMIT
    10;
results.final_sql:

results.question: Which customers have placed more than three orders? Show the first 10, ordered by order count.

        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM 
        orders

        customer_id
)

    c.full_name, 
    oc.order_count

    oc.order_count > 3

results.question: How many orders used each coupon? Also show coupons that were never used.
results.initial_sql:
WITH used_coupons AS (
    SELECT
        coupon_id,
        COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
    FROM
        orders
    WHERE
        coupon_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        coupon_id
),
unused_coupons AS (
    SELECT
        coupon_id
    FROM
        coupons
    WHERE
        coupon_id NOT IN (SELECT coupon_id FROM orders)
)
SELECT
    cu.coupon_id,
    cu.order_count
FROM
    used_coupons cu
UNION ALL
SELECT
    cu.coupon_id,
    0 AS order_count
FROM
    unused_coupons cu;
results.final_sql:
WITH used_coupons AS (
    SELECT
        coupon_id,
        COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
    FROM
        orders
    WHERE
        coupon_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        coupon_id
),
unused_coupons AS (
    SELECT
        coupon_id
    FROM
        coupons
    WHERE
        coupon_id NOT IN (SELECT coupon_id FROM orders)
)
SELECT
    cu.coupon_id,
    cu.order_count
FROM
    used_coupons cu
UNION ALL
SELECT
    cu.coupon_id,
    0 AS order_count
FROM
    unused_coupons cu;

results.question: Which five products were purchased in the largest quantities in delivered orders?
results.initial_sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN delivered_orders do ON oi.order_id = do.order_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 5;
results.final_sql:

    SELECT order_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'delivered'

results.question: Which products have an average rating above 4 and at least three reviews? Show the first 10.
results.initial_sql:
WITH product_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        COUNT(*) AS review_count,
        AVG(rating) AS average_rating
    FROM
        reviews
    GROUP BY
        product_id
    HAVING
        AVG(rating) > 4 AND COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.name,
    pr.average_rating,
    pr.review_count
FROM
    products p
JOIN
    product_reviews pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id
ORDER BY
    pr.average_rating DESC, p.product_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
results.final_sql:
